messages:
maria_fin: FYI invoice INV-7805 (NovaThera) just failed — card declined by issuer with reason 'billing address/phone mismatch'. Customer is urgent, onboarding this week.

sam_ops: Ugh, on the call now? Do we have the decline code?

maria_fin: Decline code `54X-AVS-PHONE`. Received from Stripe webhook. Attempt timestamp 2026-03-23T14:02Z.

nora_se: Is this a 3DS/authorization hold or AVS only? 3DS would show `challenge_required` in logs.

maria_fin: Looks like AVS+phone. No 3DS challenge. Card issuer blocked because billing phone is US but card issued abroad.

devon_support: Customer pinged support. They said they updated billing address but still blocked after retry. They can provide a scanned company PO and the last 4 of the card for verification.

eli_sales: Sales flagged this as high priority (PO signed). If we can accept a wire today that's fine — they'll pay via bank transfer. What's the quick wire instruction we can send?

payments-bot: Automatic retry scheduled in 24h (attempt id: rty_192345). If manual path chosen, please confirm and disable retry to avoid dupes.

maria_fin: I'll pause automated retry. @devon_support can you send wire details + tell them to include INV-7805 in reference?

devon_support: On it. Drafting email now. Wire instructions (USD) for customer:
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: First Coast Bank
Account: 123456789
Routing (ABA): 021000021
SWIFT: FCBUS33
Reference: INV-7805 / Customer name
```

maria_fin: Thanks — also asked them to upload PO and company registration to support portal for KYC. Once wire is received we mark invoice paid.

sam_ops: A couple quick asks: 1) log decline code mapping so we can detect this issuer mismatch and 2) consider adding an advisor blurb on the invoice page suggesting wire when billing country != card country. Small UX win.

nora_se: Agree. I'll add a short rule in the payment router to flag mismatched issuer-country for manual review (low risk).

eli_sales: I'll notify the AE and propose charging a manual-processing fee waiver for this first invoice to keep momentum.

maria_fin: Perfect. Devon — send wire details + request for PO now, cc me. I'll update the invoice status and disable the scheduled retry. :thumbsup:

devon_support: Sent. Subject: "Wire instructions for INV-7805 — Redwood Inference". Customer replied "thanks, sending today". Closing loop once bank posts.

payments-bot: Note: when wire posts, please mark via `payments:mark-paid` with txn id to avoid double capture by retry.
